properties.description: call_export::SOURCES is the one ordered list find() reads (the flag, the .reflow2.toml record, the MCP configurations); unconfigured() names every source by Source::hint, the persistent record first as `<root>/.reflow2.toml as [export] path = "<FILE>"`, then `--export-to <FILE>` for one call, then the MCP configurations. A source added without a phrase does not compile (exhaustive match); every_source_find_reads_is_named_in_the_no_export_line holds the class.
properties.name: The no-export line a writing --call prints is generated from the one list of sources call_export::find reads, .reflow2.toml [export] path first
